title: Number of Steps to Reduce a Number in Binary Representation to One
goal: Count add-one and halve steps needed to reduce a binary number to one.
strategy: Scan low bits while tracking carry. An effective odd bit requires an increment followed by division; an effective even bit requires division alone.
